tool.name: StarCoder2
tool.summary: BigCode's open state-of-the-art code model trained on 619 programming languages with permissive licensing, supporting infilling and 16K context, incorporating an architecture of transformer decoder with multi-query attention and Fill-in-the-Middle (FIM) training. The model demonstrates competitive performance across verified evaluations, including HumanEval: 46.3% (15B pass@1), best open model at time of release. With its 3B to 15B params design, it supports diverse local and enterprise deployment profiles under the BigCode OpenRAIL-M v1 license.
tool.architecture: Transformer decoder with multi-query attention and Fill-in-the-Middle (FIM) training.
tool.usage:
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForCausalLM
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("bigcode/starcoder2-15b")
model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained("bigcode/starcoder2-15b")
tool.benchmarks: HumanEval: 46.3% (15B pass@1), best open model at time of release
tool.limitations: Not an instruction-tuned chat model by default, requires fine-tuning for dialogue.
